name: Kishimoto Tamaki
source:
A classmate of the protagonist and the head of the school's newspaper club. She is the most well-informed person on campus and her enthusiasm is top-notch. Her reports sometime goes to far, and is considered a nuisance by the school. She notices the female teachers of the school acting strangely, and set out to investigate.
While she is a cute girl, her personality made it so she has few friends and now boyfriend.
